integrity: Proof provided with positive kernel, explicit coefficient asymptotics, and independent finite diagnostic code. Self-review is not independent audit or publication certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to four independently and angularly uniformly sampled circle endpoints, in nested concentric circles; finite straight chords only. The general same-law line-intersection theorem can recover the basic mixed integral by polarization; historical novelty is claimed only for the sharp parameter-analysis results. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A logarithmic collision cusp and complete monotonicity for nested-circle random chords
